Hi Jordan / Priya -

Thanks again for the time today. I really appreciated the candid discussion about Tellan's roadmap and the throughput/latency targets you shared. As promised, attaching the pricing deck (v3) and a simple estimate aligned to the configuration we discussed (dedicated capacity + KV caching).

Quick recap of what I heard:
- Primary use: customer-facing chat with 99th percentile latency target of <150ms
- Monthly token volume: ~1.5B tokens
- Security: SOC 2 + VPC private deployment in scope

Proposed next steps:
1) I can walk you through the deck and estimate - 30 minutes to validate assumptions and pricing
2) If that looks good, we can draft a mutual action plan and loop in procurement for terms

Proposed times (PT): Thu 5/14 10:00-10:30 or Fri 5/15 14:00-14:30 - happy to adjust. If you prefer, I can also send a calendar invite for one of these.

If you didn't receive the attachments, let me know and I'll resend via Drive/Dropbox.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

---
Note: pricing_deck_v3.pdf includes dedicated vs hosted cost breakdown and a sample rollout timeline.
